brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Semaglutide Injection (HD1916) in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Parallel-group, Multicenter, Controlled Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of Semaglutide Injection (HD1916) vs. Ozempic® as add-on to Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetics Mellitus

lead_sponsor.name: CSPC ZhongQi Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from baseline to week 32 in glycosylated haemoglobin (HbA1c)

brief_summary: To evaluate the similarity of the efficacy and safety of semaglutide injection (HD1916) vs. Ozempic® in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) with poor blood glucose control after metformin treatment.

sites.facility: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University
